When a term is exhibited in the seventh case in these sūtras, the operation directed, is to be understood as effecting the state of what immediately precedes the which the term denotes.

Terms:

An operation casused by the exhibition of a term in the Ablative 5th case, is to be understood to enjoin the substitution of something in the room of that which immediately follows the word denoted by the term.

Terms:

Of it (स्वरित-s) the first portion is उदात्त , to the extent of a half measure, or prosodial length.

Terms: स्वरित

Of this, (namely of that which has been called इत् ), there is elision.

Terms: इत्
The word-form ending in त् or in स् is called भ when an affix with the force of मतुप् 'whose is it' or 'in whom it is'

, follows.

Terms: भ संज्ञा

The affixes 1. ताम् 2. तम् 3. त 4. आम् are the substitutes of the four affixes तस् , थस् , थ and मिप् respectively of any ल which has an indicatory ङ् ।

Terms: ल
The affix अण्mentioned in प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण्

and those which follow it denote 'theh descendant of someone'.

Terms: अण्

An affix is added to a word when the sense is 'a collection thereof'.

Terms: तस्य समूहः

After a word in the Genitive -6th-Case in construction an affix is added in the sense of 'his dwelling-place' the whole word expressing the name of a country.

Terms: चातुर्थिक-अञ्

When the affix खञ् is added and when अण् is added then 1. युष्माक and 2. अस्माक are the substitutes of युष्मद् and अस्मद्।

Terms: खञ्

After the name of a subject of commentary an affix comes in the sense of 'its commentary', as well as in the sense of 'what occurs there'.

Terms: तत्रभव-अण्

The affix तसि comes in the sense of 'in the same direction with that'.

Terms: तसि
After a word in the Genitive -6th-Case in construction an affix -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण्

comes in the sense of 'this is his',

Terms: विभक्ति-6
An affix -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण्

etc., comes after a word in the Genitive -6th-Case in construction in the sense of 'a modification thereof'.

Terms: विभक्ति-6

The affix ठक् comes after a word in the Genitive -6th-Case in construction in the sense of 'its usage'.

Terms: ठक्

An affix comes after a word in the fourth case in construction, in the sense of 'good for that'.

Terms:

The above affixes have further the sense of 'for its sake', when the meaning is a relation or an unwanted appearance.

Terms:

To the same bases सार्वभूमि and पृथ्वी , are added the same affixes अण् and अञ् respectively, in the sense of 'lord thereof'.

Terms:
The above mentioned affixes

etc. come after a word in the 6th-Case in construction, in the sense of 'sown with so much'.

Terms:

The affix ठञ् comes after a word being the name of sacrifice, in the sense of 'the fee thereof'.

Terms: ठञ्

The affix ठञ् comes after the words संताप etc. in the Dative -4th Case in construction in the sense of 'what is able to effect that'.

Terms: ठञ्

The affixes त्व and तल् come in the sense of 'the nature thereof' after a word in the Genitive 6th-Case.

Terms: त्व and तल्

The affixes कुणप् (कुण) and जाहच् (जाह) come in the senses of 'the fruiting-season of this' and 'the root of this'.

Terms: कुणप् (कुण) and जाहच् (जाह)

The affix डट् (अ causing the elision of the last vowel with the consonant following it) comes in the sense of 'making full this number' after a Numeral being the Genitive 6th-Case in construction.

Terms: डट्
The affix तसिल् (तस्) is substituted for तस् -- प्रतियोगे पञ्चम्यास्तसिः
, अपादाने चाहीयरुहोः

when किम् a सर्वनाम and बहु follow.

Terms: तसिल्

After such a long vowel homogenous with the first, न् is substituted for the स् of the Acccusative case affix शस् in the masculine.

Terms: संहितायाम्
The Personal-endings and their substitutes
-126 are, when they are सार्वधातुक

etc., unaccented after the charactertistic of the Periphrastic Future (तासि) after a root which in the धातुपाठ has an unaccented vowel or a ङ् (with the exception of ह्नुङ् and इङ्) as indicatory letter, as well as after what has a final अ in the Grammatical System of Instruction (उपदेश)।

Terms: accent-विभक्ति
A feminine word not ending in the affix ऊङ् and having an equivalent and uniform masculine is changed into such masculine form, before the affixes beginning with तसिल् etc. -- पञ्चम्यास्तसिल्
, and ending with कृत्वसुच् -- संख्यायाः क्रियाऽभ्यावृत्तिगणने कृत्वसुच्

.

Terms: Masculisation

After the above न-elided of the Negative Particle नञ् (i.e. after अ) is added the augment नुट् to a word beginning with a vowel.

Terms: नुट् Augment

For the ending त of the 2nd person plural Imperative is substituted तात्‌ in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms: छन्दस् substitution

The परस्मैपद आर्धधातुक affixes beginning with स् and the affix तास् (the sign of the Periphrastic Future) do not get the इट् augment after the root कॢप्।

Terms: इट् augment

The final स् of तास् (the character of the second future) and अस् 'to be' is elided before an affix beginning with स् ।

Terms: Elision

After such a lengthened आ of the reduplicate there is added the augment नुट् (न्) to the short अ of the root which ends in a double consonant.

Terms: Reduplicate

Of that which is twice uttered, the latter form is called अम्रेडित (repeated).

Terms: Doubling of Words
